notes: Batch lists this as a combined 2-account entry ('953959+974441') for one census_id, but these are two physically distinct, separately-branded apartment communities on adjacent parcels along E Olympic Dr: The Bower (404, PROP_ID 953959) and Brio (705, PROP_ID 974441). PROP_ID 974441 (Brio) returns NO match in the Travis County GIS parcel layer (likely un-platted/geometry not yet published for this newer parcel), though it is a valid, actively-referenced TCAD account per the batch data and Wilson Capital's own portfolio naming. IMPORTANT: multiple independent apartment-listing sources (Apartments.com, Yelp, Zillow, Redfin) give the actual city as PFLUGERVILLE, TX 78660 -- not Austin -- for both 404 and 705 E Olympic Dr; the batch's 'city: Austin' field appears to be an approximation/error. Both properties are managed by Greystar but developed and (per the ABJ/Thorofare article) still owned/sponsored by Wilson Capital, consistent with the fee-flip/ground-lease structure documented in docs/phase1_verdict.md (developer retains operating control after HFC title transfer).
